div.div:
What is missing today
• No central registry — the approved set lives in CAH config
• No first-party traceparent; LangGraph mints a server-side UUID request_id
• Token tracking only; no cost, no budget, no chargeback join
• No external policy authority; guardrails are product-level, not platform-level
